verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions premium domain pricing in search results, aftermarket listings, a marketplace, or a broker service for taken names. Generic upfront at-cost pricing and API search/check capabilities are adjacent and do not show premium or aftermarket support. Domain-search depth is a fair axis for a registrar, so this is 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As a power user, premium and aftermarket domains are first-class — premium pricing shown in search, and a marketplace or broker path for taken names
